direct.prompt: Use Avoid AI Writing to clean this draft.
Use the AI Writing Detector and flag only.
Use the Preservation Verifier on these two versions.

indirect.prompt: What AI-ish patterns are in this paragraph? Do not change it.
Make this sound less machine-written but keep my voice and every number.
Clean notes.md directly, only the prose that needs it.
Did this rewrite accidentally change any links, code, tables, or figures?
These flags look suspicious, but how much can the text alone really establish?
Scan, rewrite, and check that nothing important changed.

handoff.prompt: First audit this, then rewrite only the flagged prose and verify the result.
The verifier says the returned rewrite changed a URL. Fix only that preservation error and verify again.
The verifier says the edited file changed frontmatter. Repair the file itself and verify again.
After the rewrite, run one residual audit because I asked you to iterate until clean.

guards.prompt: Clean this image-generation prompt, but keep the Saudi setting, wheelchair details, abaya description, skin-tone lighting notes, and anti-stereotype constraints exactly meaningful.
Rewrite this technical detector report without changing its score, context mode, or uncertainty language.

ambiguous.prompt: Clean this up but only tell me what's wrong, don't rewrite it.
Rewrite draft.md and save the changes in that file.
Rewrite this prompt describing a family in Jeddah.
